newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-STRASBOURG BEGIN NEW ERA UNDER IMG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRASBOURG BEGIN NEW ERA UNDER IMG.

text.p: French League Cup finalists Strasbourg began a new era on Tuesday under the IMG sports management group which has bought a 49 percent stake in the club for five million francs ($870,000).
The head of the French branch of American Mark McCormack's IMG organisation, former French number one tennis player Patrick Proisy, was due to take the reins as club president.
Jean-Francois Domergue, general manager of first division rivals Paris St Germain, has been offered a similar position by Strasbourg and will make a decision this week.
Proisy, who is planning to build a championship winning side, said he wants to increase IMG's stake and invest 150 million francs ($26 million) in the club over the next five years.

He has declared striker David Zitelli, the first division's leading scorer, and playmaker Pascal Nouma as not open to transfer bids and will also be looking to sign top players to strengthen the squad.
Strasbourg, fourth in the first division standings, meet Bordeaux in the League Cup final in Paris on April 12.
They have won the first division championship once, in 1979. They gained promotion from the second division in 1993.
